# Server-only actions: the half of the client route contract that is not a
# route. tests/integration/83_route_contract.sh fails on any manifest action
# that is neither a C client route (src/hyperfide/client.c) nor listed here,
# and on any line here that names a missing or routed action.
#
#   <component> *         every action of a component no client command reaches
#   <component> <action>  one action of a client-routed component kept server-side
#
# A new client-facing action gets a route in client.c, never a line here.
